parsed.rationale: All three types — `PlaybackBlendMode`, `MaterialBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — live in the same `Wallpaper` package and each independently declares an identical `displayName` computed property at line 41 of their respective files. Because the implementations are exactly duplicated (query: `function-duplicates-exact`) and no restraint markers are set on any record, the idiomatic Swift fix is to introduce a protocol `BlendModeDisplayable` with a default implementation of `displayName` in a protocol extension, eliminating all three per-type copies. The `_Plant_` prefix on `_Plant_OverlayBlendMode.swift` suggests it may be a staging/draft type, but it is still production code (all context flags false) and benefits equally from the shared default.
